headline: ADI lists AMS model-verification roles spanning data converters, fidelity and reusable testbenches
fact: ADI posted Wilmington Advanced Data-converter Group role R263851 on August 4 for analog circuit/system models, mixed-signal SoC connectivity/functional verification and usage-scenario testbenches, requesting SystemVerilog RNM, Verilog-AMS or SystemC. Related Austin/Durham Senior AMS Design Verification role R266818, dated October 13, assigns reusable SystemVerilog/UVM/RNM architecture, behavioral-model validation and fidelity/performance tradeoffs, requirements-traceable coverage, calibration/power-mode checks and regression/triage infrastructure. The later role is grouped with this existing AMS model-verification hiring milestone; a shared team is not established. Neither description assigns AI/ML modeling.

sources.title: Analog Devices Careers: Mixed Signal Design Verification Engineer (R263851)
sources.summary: Official employer page and public job data confirm the data-converter SoC modeling mandate. JobPosting datePosted and job-data startDate both identify August 4, 2026.
